packageRules.description: Anything baked into the refresh image releases a new image on merge (auto-release.yml). Reviewed by hand, never automerged; the deploy follows through the automerged image-pin PR below.
prBodyNotes: Merging this releases a new refresh image through auto-release. Renovate then opens and automerges the image-pin PR, whose deploy waits for idle jobs; confirm that deploy finished.

packageRules.description: These registries give no release timestamp; without this their updates would wait forever.

The Azure image pin automerges at any time, because merging it IS the deploy: the push to main runs azure-deploy.yml, which applies only when .github/scripts/azure_release_guard.py accepts the plan (an in-place image-only update of both jobs, equal to this pin's digest) and no job is running or about to fire. Our own releases skip the 7-day release age, and the pin is exempt from the PR limits so a release never waits behind other Renovate PRs (0 = unlimited). CI must pass before Renovate merges. Only CalVer releases are proposed (allowedVersions), and azure-deploy refuses a pin whose tag is not on main or no longer resolves to the pinned digest. Remove this rule to merge pin PRs by hand (a merged pin still deploys).

customManagers.description: Claude Code CLI pinned for the refresh image.
Base and test images pinned by tag and digest.
Terraform CLI used by CI and the operator.

The Azure image pin, infra/azure/image.auto.tfvars.json. `image` stays digest-only because Terraform deploys exactly that reference (Container Apps acceptance of name:tag@digest is unverified); `image_version` carries the release tag Renovate compares. Both are bumped together from one registry lookup.
